findings.remediation: A Wikipedia article and a Wikidata item are how an engine turns a name into an entity it can reason about. Neither can be created to order, and writing your own is against Wikipedia's conflict-of-interest guidance. What you can do is earn the independent coverage those pages require, and make sure the facts an editor would need are easy to find on your own site.
